method.producer: tests/siesta_wfsx_fixtures/measurement_producer.py:generate_measurement_case (bounded measurement extension of the SHA256SUMS-pinned Story 002 producer driver, reusing the existing fixture_driver helpers; unchanged O2 SZP/PBE/100K physical template, repeat_z=1; only the k-grid and the exact template fields named in changed_template_fields differ)
method.runner: tests/siesta_wfsx_fixtures/run_benchmarks.py:run_matched_pair (shared benchmark slice; no duplicated measurement pipeline)
method.cache_policy_note: passed explicitly to run_matched_pair; the runner owns the cold/warm mechanics (per-input POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED cold advice where available; warm = immediately repeated fresh process on the same inputs) and records them per run
method.integration: run_matched_pair defaults: magnetic O, Rcut 4.3 A, nz 8, nproc 1, smearing 100 kB, complete_spectrum True, metadata EF shift 0; kmesh from the measurement mesh; explicit full requested fractional points with uniform weights

tensor_unit.runner_serialization: meV, verified against tensors_meta.<mode>.unit before any statistic is computed
tensor_unit.report_conversion: none; thresholds are evaluated directly in the serialized meV values
tensor_unit.note: an unexpected unit aborts the campaign instead of applying an unverified conversion

method.alignment: successive refinements are compared on the exactly aligned full-tensor R/site domain (all keys, including zero blocks); unequal full R/site key sets refuse the comparison
rules: converged iff BOTH successive refinements meet BOTH thresholds
each step is judged on its own measured change; monotonic decrease is never assumed
the relative criterion counts only elements with |reference| > 0.1 meV; an active count of zero is an explicit vacuous determination, never a NaN pass
any non-finite tensor element fails its step
the same-mesh ordinary/WFSX equivalence proof is carried separately and does not enter the refinement verdict
